description: Your answer for this turn: play, resign or accept a draw offer, as the fields say.

action.description: What you do this turn, exactly one of "move", "resign" or "accept_draw". "move": you play the entry given in move. "resign": you give up and lose the game; move is null. "accept_draw": you accept the draw your opponent offered, and the game ends in a draw; only allowed while the message says a draw offer is pending; move is null.
action.title: Action

move.description: Required when action is "move", otherwise null. Exactly one entry from the legal list in the message (the list of everything you may play this turn), copied unchanged, character for character: no other notation, no numbering, no added or removed symbols or spaces, no explanation, no Markdown and no other text.
move.title: Move

offer_draw.description: true only together with action "move": you play the move and offer your opponent a draw, which they may accept on their turn. false in every other case.
offer_draw.title: Offer Draw

title: answer
